theorems.name: Submission.fiw_total_boundedness
theorems.statement: DeformationTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ (B : ℝ≥0∞), B ≠ ∞ → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j).boundary) → (∀ j, (Tj j).support ⊆ K) → (∀ j, (Tj j).mass + (Tj j).boundary.mass ≤ B) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ J : Set ℕ, J.Infinite → ∃ J' ⊆ J, J'.Infinite ∧ ∀ i ∈ J', ∀ j ∈ J', ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1 + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, Tj i ω - Tj j ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
